text:
The waves crash, a symphony of sound
A melody that fills the air with grace
The ocean's rhythm is a constant flow
A never-ending stream of life and light

The tides ebb and flow, a cycle of time
A dance of change, a journey to be seen
The ocean's power is immense, a force to be reckoned with
A masterpiece of nature, a work of art to behold

The sun sets on the horizon, a golden hue
A reminder of the beauty that lies beyond
The ocean's vastness, a canvas for all to see
A masterpiece, a work of art that will endure.
